headline: Verify release news against the actual previous published build

changes.title: Resolve the last published ancestor instead of the current release
changes.detail: The optional news audit now selects the newest published tag strictly preceding the checked-out commit, excluding tags for the same revision or unrelated branches. A release published during CI can no longer make the changelog appear unchanged against itself.

changes.title: Retain meaningful freshness and coverage failures
changes.detail: Complete git ancestry is available to the diagnostics job, and the unchanged source coverage validator still rejects missing release-note edits and unreported player-facing file changes.

changes.title: Test release-tag ordering and ancestry without touching gameplay
changes.detail: A report-only test covers self-tag exclusion, newer and unrelated tags, missing release history, and the existing release-news source-coverage safeguards.
